sub_tasks.sub_task: Engineer sets up computational environment and prepares datasets.
bullet_points: Install required libraries (e.g., PyTorch, NumPy, SciPy).
Generate synthetic datasets for baseline experiments.
Save datasets in structured formats (e.g., HDF5, CSV) for reproducibility.
Implement multiple reparametrization techniques (e.g., affine transformations, nonlinear mappings).
Compute gradients and Jacobians for each reparametrization.
Perform symmetry checks to validate theoretical invariance criteria.
Calculate diagonal and off-diagonal elements of the Fisher information matrix.
Use model-specific gradients and Hessian approximations.
Save numerical results for downstream analysis.
Train SGD on baseline and reparametrized models.
Track gradient norms, loss curves, and convergence rates.
Compare results against theoretical expectations (e.g., gradient behavior).
Plot gradient behavior, Fisher matrix conditioning, and convergence metrics.
Create tables summarizing key statistics (e.g., gradient norms, training times).
Export figures and tables for inclusion in the results section.
Structure results into subsections (e.g., "Gradient Behavior," "Fisher Matrix Analysis").
Interpret plots and tables in the context of theoretical invariance.
Discuss implications for optimization stability and convergence.
Reference all generated figures and tables in the narrative.
